item.text: {"explanation":"The conditional rule is state conservation: after each event, the output reports exactly the active transfer and its distinct known byte positions; accepted chunks add only nonconflicting bytes, while invalid, conflicting, and irrelevant events leave state unchanged. A counterexample is an overlapping chunk with one differing byte: rejecting only that byte would incorrectly preserve the rest, so the entire chunk must be rejected.","mapping":"config.maxLength and event fields map to transfer state {id,len,bytes}; null byte entries represent unknown positions. Output status, id, received, and data are a direct projection of the post-event state and operation result.","assumptions":"Inputs use the documented JSON value domains; malformed or unknown operations are treated as ignored, and malformed chunk payloads as invalid. IDs use strict equality.","applies":"function applies(input){return !!input&&!!input.config&&Array.isArray(input.events)}","holds":"function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;let s=null;for(let k=0;k<input.events.length;k++){let e=input.events[k],st='ignored',id=s?s.id:null,d=null;if(e&&e.type==='begin'){if(Number.isInteger(e.length)&&e.length>=0&&e.length<=input.config.maxLength){if(s&&s.id===e.id&&s.len!==e.length)st='conflict';else{if(!s||s.id!==e.id)s={id:e.id,len:e.length,b:Array(e.length).fill(null)};st='ok'}}else st='invalid'}else if(e&&e.type==='chunk'){if(s&&s.id===e.id){let b=e.bytes,good=Array.isArray(b)&&Number.isInteger(e.offset)&&e.offset>=0&&e.offset+(b?b.length:0)<=s.len&&Number.isInteger(e.checksum);let sum=0;if(good)for(let x of b){if(!Number.isInteger(x)||x<0||x>255){good=false;break}sum+=x}if(good&&sum%251!==e.checksum)good=false;if(!good)st='invalid';else{let c=false;for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++)if(s.b[e.offset+i]!==null&&s.b[e.offset+i]!==b[i])c=true;if(c)st='conflict';else{for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++)s.b[e.offset+i]=b[i];st='ok'}}}}else if(e&&e.type==='finish'&&s&&s.id===e.id){let complete=s.b.every(x=>x!==null);st=complete?'complete':'incomplete';if(complete)d=s.b.slice()}let r=0;if(s)for(let x of s.b)if(x!==null)r++;let want={status:st,id:id,received:r,data:d};if(JSON.stringify(want)!==JSON.stringify(output[k]))return false}return true}","program":"function solve({config,state,event}){let s=state;if(!s)s={id:null,len:0,b:[]};let st='ignored',d=null;if(event&&event.type==='begin'){if(Number.isInteger(event.length)&&event.length>=0&&event.length<=config.maxLength){if(s.id!==null&&s.id===event.id&&s.len!==event.length)st='conflict';else{if(s.id===null||s.id!==event.id)s={id:event.id,len:event.length,b:Array(event.length).fill(null)};st='ok'}}else st='invalid'}else if(event&&event.type==='chunk'){if(s.id!==null&&s.id===event.id){let b=event.bytes,good=Array.isArray(b)&&Number.isInteger(event.offset)&&event.offset>=0&&Number.isInteger(event.checksum)&&event.offset+(b?b.length:0)<=s.len,sum=0;if(good)for(let x of b){if(!Number.isInteger(x)||x<0||x>255){good=false;break}sum+=x}if(good&&sum%251!==event.checksum)good=false;if(!good)st='invalid';else{let c=false;for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++)if(s.b[event.offset+i]!==null&&s.b[event.offset+i]!==b[i])c=true;if(c)st='conflict';else{for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++)s.b[event.offset+i]=b[i];st='ok'}}}}else if(event&&event.type==='finish'&&s.id!==null&&s.id===event.id){let complete=s.b.every(x=>x!==null);st=complete?'complete':'incomplete';if(complete)d=s.b.slice()}let r=0;for(let x of s.b)if(x!==null)r++;return{state:s,output:{status:st,id:s.id,received:r,data:d}}}"}
